title: Feeling Tip Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked into the heart of 30A’s Prominence community, this thoughtfully designed townhome offers the perfect mix of style, comfort, and convenience. With three bedrooms and two and a half baths, it easily accommodates up to seven guests, making it ideal for family escapes or group getaways. The open-concept main floor is perfect for gathering, whether around the dining table, in the living room with ample seating, or out on the private patio. A fully equipped kitchen, in-unit laundry, and included six-seater golf cart and four bikes add effortless ease to every stay. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property.
